notes.subject: givim strongpela nek
notes.rationale: ויתנו ערף literal idiom 'give the neck', i.e. turn the back; Tok Pisin keeps the body-part picture with 'strongpela nek' per D4c

notes.subject: wokim olgeta nating
notes.rationale: מעל act covertly/treacherously; no single Tok Pisin word covers 'act unfaithfully'

notes.subject: em
notes.rationale: object pronoun added for ויעזבהו (forsake him); Hebrew suffix has no free-standing Tok Pisin equivalent

translation: Bihain long ol mama i karim ol papa bilong yumi ol i wokim olgeta nating, ol i mekim olsem nogut tru long ai bilong Yahwe Elohim bilong yumi, na ol i lusim ⟨את⟩ em, na ol i karamapim ol pes bilong ol i go we long Miskan bilong Yahwe, na ol i givim ⟨את⟩ strongpela nek.

tokens.gloss: ol mama i karim ol papa bilong yumi
i go we long Miskan bilong
